components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3.4rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2.5rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #151412; background: #c9825a; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.74rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 220ms ease, background 220ms ease, border-color 220ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: #c9825a; color: #c9825a; background: transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9825a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Nav Link

components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 0.6rem 0; color: #d4cfc5; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.74rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0.35rem; left: 0; height: 1px; content: ''; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #c9825a; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9825a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-project { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(18rem, 0.7fr); align-items: start; gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem); } .ds-project-media { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 1.65; overflow: hidden; background: #25211d; } .ds-project-media::after { position: absolute; inset: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(238, 233, 223, 0.22); content: ''; pointer-events: none; } .ds-project-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; filter: saturate(0.7) contrast(1.02); transition: transform 750ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 450ms ease; } .ds-project-media:hover .ds-project-img { filter: saturate(1) contrast(1.02); transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-project-launch { position: absolute; z-index: 3; top: 1rem; right: 1rem; display: grid; width: 3.1rem; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; color: #151412; background: #c9825a; font-size: 1.15rem; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-project-media:hover .ds-project-launch { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-project-number { margin-bottom: 1.4rem; color: #c9825a; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-project-details h3 { margin: 0 0 1.3rem; font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.9rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.055em; color: #eee9df; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; } .ds-project-details p { max-width: 50ch; margin: 0; color: #d4cfc5; line-height: 1.75; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: This portfolio reads like a clean workshop bench: every element has a reason to be there, and the warm accent is the tool that gets picked up most. The design rejects decoration without function. It is dark, grounded, and precise—built for hiring managers who scan fast and want to see real craft without theatrical flair.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, warm-on-dark backgrounds with a single warm sandstone accent.
Angular, not rounded. Sharp clip-paths and 0px radii throughout.
Section numbers as vertical wayfinding on desktop.
Restrained motion with full reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Warm sandstone is the only saturated color. Use it for the primary action, the current location, and one deliberate emphasis per section.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are tinted warm (#151412, not #000). Text is tinted cream (#eee9df, not #fff).

rules.name: The Big Type, Small Type Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built on scale contrast and weight, not on many intermediate sizes. Use display/headline/title/body/label only.

rules.name: The Caps Are Labels Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + wide tracking is reserved for metadata, navigation, and tags. Never uppercase body text.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat. Use tonal contrast or a thin line to separate them, not drop shadows.

rules.name: The Glass Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur appears only when an element must float above content that still needs to be partially visible. Otherwise use solid ink-soft.

dos: Do keep the warm sandstone accent rare and intentional.
Do use Manrope for everything except metadata, which uses DM Mono.
Do maintain sharp corners on every component; radii are 0.
Do use subtle warm tints on neutrals instead of pure black or white.
donts: Don't use gradient text or gradient buttons.
Don't use side-stripe borders as accents on cards, lists, or callouts.
Don't use generic SaaS/template portfolio clichés.
Don't use cold corporate palette: navy + white, stock visuals, impersonal language.
Don't introduce a second saturated accent color.
Don't round corners or add soft shadows to every surface.
Don't use em dashes in copy.
